Name: SkipInteraction
Author: MniShark
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Skip Interaction 跳过交互[/b][/size][/center]

[center]按住修饰键，一键完成常见交互：快速进食、跳过矿井确认、自定义确认键。[/center]
[center]Hold a modifier key to speed up common interactions: quick eat, skip mine confirmations, custom confirm key.[/center]

[center][url=https://duk.tw/sblAAM.gif][img]https://duk.tw/sblAAM.gif[/img][/url]
[/center]
[line]

[size=5][b]功能 · Features[/b][/size]


[size=4][b]跳过梯子 / 竖井 / 进食确认 · Skip Ladder / Shaft / Eat Confirmation[/b][/size]
按住修饰键（默认左 Ctrl）：
Hold the modifier key (Left Ctrl by default):
- 右键点击手持食物 → 直接吃掉，跳过"要吃掉这个吗"的确认
- Right-click the held food → eat instantly, skipping the "Eat this?" confirmation
- 点击向上的梯子 → 直接离开矿井，跳过确认框
- Click the upward ladder → leave the mine immediately, skipping the confirmation
- 点击竖井 → 直接跳下，跳过确认框（注意：跳竖井仍会扣血）
- Click a shaft → jump down immediately, skipping the confirmation (Warning: shafts still deal fall damage)

[size=4][b]自定义确认键 · Custom Confirm Key[/b][/size]
把任意键设为"确认键"，在任何对话框或菜单中，按下自定义键等同于按下 Y 键。
Bind any key as your "confirm" key. In any dialogue or menu, pressing your custom key acts exactly like pressing Y.

[size=4][b]游戏内配置 · In-Game Config[/b][/size]
所有功能都可在游戏内的 GMCM（Generic Mod Config Menu）菜单中开关、修改键位，无需重启游戏。
All features can be toggled and rebound in-game via GMCM (Generic Mod Config Menu) without restarting the game.

[line]

[size=5][b]使用方法 · Usage[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]快速进食：按住修饰键 + 右键点击手持的食物
Quick Eat: Hold modifier + right-click the held food[/*]
[*]跳过梯子：按住修饰键 + 点击向上的梯子
Skip Ladder: Hold modifier + click the upward ladder[/*]
[*]跳过竖井：按住修饰键 + 点击竖井
Skip Shaft: Hold modifier + click a shaft[/*]
[*]自定义确认键：菜单打开时按下你绑定的键即可
Custom Confirm Key: Press your bound key while a menu is open[/*]
[/list]

Custom confirm key feature. Bind any key(s) to confirm in dialogues/menus — same as pressing Y.
